methodology.scope: Every .zip under the repository except .git. Virtual environments were included in the walk and contained no ZIP files.
methodology.hash: SHA-256 of the ZIP file bytes. Member payload fingerprint is SHA-256 over sorted lines of member path, uncompressed size, and SHA-256 of uncompressed member bytes.
methodology.integrity: zipfile.testzip() on every repository ZIP after the inventory hash. No bad member was returned.
methodology.logical_comparison: Identical payload fingerprints with different file hashes would be logical duplicates. None were found. Same member-name sets with different payload fingerprints are different versions. Jaccard at or above 0.80 on review-package member names is recorded as overlap.
methodology.git_bytes: For every tracked ZIP, git hash-object --no-filters matched the index blob id, and the worktree was clean. Those exact file bytes are the Git blob.
methodology.references: Exact-duplicate paths were searched in 48,437 text files. Six JSON files larger than 30 MB were excluded from that bulk read and checked separately for the candidate directory names. Generic basenames REVIEW.zip, CURRENT_REVIEW.zip, and evidence.zip were not treated as references.
